summary: Institutional positioning is heavily focused on long-term volatility hedging and massive, balanced bets on the SPX, evidenced by the $7.7B premium and heavy accumulation in both 7000C and 8000P strikes for 2026/2027. The most significant conviction lies in the persistent, multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C (over $3.1B) and SPX 8000P (over $2.2B) for the Sept 2026 expiry, suggesting a "strangle" strategy or a massive long-term volatility play. While AMD and SNDK show aggressive bullish call buying (P/C ratios of 0.17 and 0.38 respectively), the sheer scale of the SPX 7000C and 8000P positions indicates institutions are bracing for extreme wide-range movement over the next two years. Traders should watch for SPX price action near the 7000 level and monitor MU for follow-through, given the $209.6M accumulation in 1190P.
